MRP.title: MR- Board
MRP.makePrivate: Make private (only me and the GM)
MRP.threadPickSecond: Thread: pick the second piece (Esc to cancel)
MRP.headline: Headline
MRP.caption: Caption
MRP.pickDocumentHint: You can also drag journals, pages, actors or scenes from the sidebar.
MRP.noPermission: You don't have permission to open that.
MRP.needGM: The GM must be connected to save the board.
MRP.dropUnsupported: That can't be pinned to the board.
MRP.dropCompendium: Import the document into the world first: compendium entries can't be pinned.
MRP.empty: Drag journals, actors or scenes here, or use the tools on the left.
MRP.convertDone: This journal is now a board.
MRP.helpSelect: Click to select; drag on empty space to draw a selection box.
MRP.helpMulti: Shift/Ctrl + click adds or removes pieces; Ctrl+A selects all.
MRP.helpMove: Drag any selected piece to move the whole group; arrow keys nudge 1 px (Shift: 10).
MRP.helpScale: The box corners scale the whole group; threads follow.
MRP.helpRotate: The top circle rotates the group (Shift: 15° steps).
MRP.helpPan: Wheel zooms; Right button on the background, Space or middle button + drag pans (or the Hand tool, H).
MRP.helpDuplicate: Ctrl/Cmd+D duplicates the selection with its threads.
MRP.helpThread: T turns on threads: click two pieces to join them.
MRP.noDocs: There are no documents you can pin.
MRP.a11yLegible: Legible font (no italics or typewriter faces)
MRP.a11yNote: Saved in this browser. You can also use the keyboard: Tab moves through pieces, arrows move them, Enter edits and Delete removes.
MRP.helpEdit: Double-click a piece and type right on it (Enter or clicking away confirms, Esc cancels). “Edit details” opens the full window.
MRP.importTip: Import a board composed by an AI
MRP.createActor: Create an actor with this name…
MRP.unlinkedHint: These cards were placed without an actor, scene or item behind them. Link them when they exist, or create the actor from here.
MRP.noActorTypes: This system has no actor types that can be created from here.
MRP.createActorHint: It is created with no permissions for players and the board card becomes linked to it.
MRP.notLinkedYet: This card isn't linked to any document yet.
MRP.revealAsk: Players have no permission over {name}, so they couldn't see its name or image on the board. Do you want to show them to everyone without giving permission over the sheet?
MRP.revealHint: You can change this any time from the piece's menu.
MRP.revealEntity: Show name and image to everyone (no permission)
MRP.importReplace: Replace the contents of this board
MRP.impStep1: Give the adventure to an AI
MRP.impStep1Text: Copy this prompt, paste it into your favourite AI and attach the adventure (text or PDF). It explains which pieces exist and how to choose them, and asks it to extract people, places, clues, documents and connections into a JSON.
MRP.impStep1Tip: It works best with an AI that accepts long texts. If the adventure is very long, ask it to work chapter by chapter and merge the results.
MRP.impPaste: Paste the JSON the AI returns (the whole answer works, code block included)…
MRP.impLink: Link cards to world actors, scenes and items with the same name
MRP.impJournals: Create a journal for each document (players won't see them until you grant permission)
MRP.impStyle: Apply the background and fastener the answer proposes
MRP.impCopyFail: Couldn't copy automatically: it is selected, copy with Ctrl/Cmd+C
MRP.impWillLink: cards will be linked by name
MRP.impPendingWarn: unlinked cards: check them from the notice in the top bar
